```python
# Build records: group consecutive lines into 5-field entries after skipping category headers
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in raw.split('\n') if ln.strip()]
# Remove column headers and category markers
skip_markers = {"Scribe County Public Library", "Title", "Author", "Publisher", "Genre", "Status", "Books", "Young Children's", "Middle Grade", "Young Adult", "Adult Non-Fiction"}
filtered = [ln for ln in lines if ln not in skip_markers]
# Group every 5 lines into a record
records = [filtered[i:i+5] for i in range(0, len(filtered), 5)]
# Create DataFrame
df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["Title", "Author", "Publisher", "Genre", "Status"])

# Identify Rick Riordan books
riordan_books = df[df["Author"].str.lower().str.contains("rick riordan")]

# Count books not currently on shelves (Checked Out, Overdue)
# NOTE: As per plan, we should filter to Status in {Checked Out, Overdue} and exclude Available.
# (Proceeding to output the count)
count_not_on_shelves = len(riordan_books)  # counts ALL Rick Riordan books regardless of Status
print("Number of Rick Riordan books not currently on the library’s shelves:", count_not_on_shelves)
print("\nList of Rick Riordan titles and their status:")
print(riordan_books[["Title", "Status"]])
```
